text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My favorite clothing store is having a
sale, so I
decide to drop by.

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This one is so cuuuute! I saw it in a
magazine!

text_block_list.name: Trend-chasing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What do you think, Nature? I think
you'd look
good in this color.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I'm okay. This kind of stuff isn't my
style,
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fashionable Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Shut up! You could totally pull it off!

text_block_list.name: Trend-chasing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We're going to try these on. You really
should try
one too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay. If the feeling strikes me,
then maybe.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, heya, Trainer. What a coincidence
meeting
you here. Are you buying some
new clothes too?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see. So... why's your shopping cart
empty then?
choice_data_list: セール中に買い込んでおきたくて
choice_data_list_en: I wanted to stock up during the sale.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Why not leave it to me? I'll fill
your cart in
no time.
choice_data_list: 服が豊富だから決まらなくて
choice_data_list_en: There are so many clothes, I just can't decide.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Why not leave it to me? I'll fill
your cart in
no time.
choice_data_list: それよりさっき見てた可愛い服は？
ぜひ！けど友だちはいいのか？
ぜひ！けど友だちはいいの？
choice_data_list_en: More importantly, what about that cute outfit you were looking at earlier?
Definitely! But are your friends fine with that?
Definitely! But are your friends fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah... this?
choice_data_list: それよりさっき見てた可愛い服は？
ぜひ！けど友だちはいいのか？
ぜひ！けど友だちはいいの？
choice_data_list_en: More importantly, what about that cute outfit you were looking at earlier?
Definitely! But are your friends fine with that?
Definitely! But are your friends fine with that?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They told me it would look good on me,
but ruffly
clothes just aren't my style.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm more of a plain clothes kinda gal,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay, okay, enough flattery.
choice_data_list: そんなことない、似合うぞ！
そんなことない、似合うよ！
choice_data_list_en: Not at all, it looks great on you!
Not at all, it looks really good on you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're here to buy clothes for yourself,
right?
Why don't you go ahead and pick
something.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You can pout all you want, but I am not wearing this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, don't be like that. You're old
enough to
know when to give up, right?
choice_data_list_en: It would definitely look good on you, though...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
F-fine. If you insist, I guess I can at least
hold it
up in front of me so you can get
an idea.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna go really fast, so don't blink.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Done. That's it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I said that's it, so that's it! No matter
what you
say!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
choice_data_list: やっぱり似合ってたよ！
choice_data_list_en: It really looked great on you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... Show's over! Now skedaddle!
Better yet,
I'll skedaddle!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Goodbye, Trainer! Make sure to delete
that
image from your memory too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as she finishes speaking, Nice
Nature runs
off...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...With the clothes we were just talking
about still
in hand.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm just here because they wanted to
come here.
Besides, they told me I don't
have to stick
around.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Can you wait here for a second? I'll go
tell them.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Okay. Shall we start?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now what you would look good in...
Never really
seen you in flashy clothes,
but maybe it could be
your new thing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I like choosing clothes for other people.
Just not
the other way around.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Especially when they pick something
cutesy. I just
feel bad because I know it
won't look good on
me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Please. Not you too.
choice_data_list_en: I think it suits you, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
We're here to pick out clothes for you.
Forget
about me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Nice Nature, I find a lot of
good
clothes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although, that means that I've got my
work cut
out lugging it all home.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well. You've got one heck of
a haul
there.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Well, you are my trainer, after all.
choice_data_list: ネイチャの見立てがよかったからな
ネイチャの見立てがよかったからね
choice_data_list_en: Nature had good judgment, after all.
That was thanks to Nature's keen eye.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I care about you, even if it doesn't seem
that way.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, let me carry some of that
stuff for
you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Your arms are shaking, and I can't bear
to watch
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't be stubborn now! You're not a
child!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oof, there we go! Okay, we're off!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as my arms are at their limit, I

begrudgingly hand Nice Nature a few
bags, and
we make our way back to
campus.
